title: Incentivizing Information Exchange Within Groups: The Role of Voting Protocols in U.S. Food and Drug Administration Advisory Committees
eligible_reason: Single 2007 FDA-wide switch from sequential to simultaneous voting: Post = 1 for all meetings after the switch (checked in Meetings.dta: Post turns on within 2007 for all committees, no never-treated committee). Regressions are committee-FE before/after comparisons without calendar-time FE (adding i.MeetingYear is a robustness column). Not a staggered DiD.
design_notes: Stata. Code.do: xtset Committee; xtreg InfoDiversity Post [$MCTRLS] if MotionID==1, fe vce(cl Committee) (Table 1); same for pDirectedQs, sdTalkTime, LIWC measures (Table 2); reg ApprovedAdCom/ApprovedFDA Post (Tables 3-4); probit/xtreg Unanimous Post (+InfoDiversity mediator). 563 meetings 1999-2016.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One policy date (2007) for all FDA advisory committees.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common switch date, no untreated comparison group, no calendar-time FE

data_files_note: Hand-collected from FDA advisory committee transcripts and minutes.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.txt, Code.do, Meetings.dta).
